policy.title: GPU policy
items: Every card has a standing owner (see Card assignment). Use your own cards freely.
To use someone else's card, the owner must have switched on Can share, and you agree the details with them in the WeChat group first.
Run only on cards you own or were given: set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES accordingly.
Stop and free the memory as soon as a run is done; do not park idle processes on a card.
Near a deadline, say so in the group (and fill in your Targets row); owners are encouraged to share.

penalty.title: Penalties
items: A job running on a card you neither own nor were given may be killed without notice.
Cards held idle for more than 24 hours: the processes are killed by an admin.
Repeated violations: access to shared cards suspended for one week.

chat.label: WeChat group
chat.emphasis: Communicate first to get more GPU resources.
